zombie-city-polygon-survival.description: Zombie City Polygon Survival is an action-packed, polygonal-style shooter where players navigate a post-apocalyptic city overrun by zombies. Armed with guns, players must survive waves of relentless enemies, utilizing tactical strategy and quick reflexes to clear each area. The game's minimalist graphics and intense combat offer thrilling survival gameplay. Ready to test your skills? Play Zombie City Polygon Survival now!
